non_applicable.data-sensitivity-levels: Conceptual taxonomy with no SDK implementation requirement.

non_applicable.before-send-transaction-hook: The SDK only does span streaming and never creates transaction events, so there is nothing for this hook to apply to.

non_applicable.terms: Definitions only; no SDK implementation requirement.
non_applicable.purpose-decides-category: Conceptual guidance on categorizing operations; no SDK implementation requirement.
non_applicable.user-set-data: Defers to data-collection#user-set-data-scrubbing and has no standalone requirement.

non_applicable.otel-context-alignment: Applies only to SDKs that instrument through OpenTelemetry; the Python SDK uses its own instrumentation.

non_applicable.units: Only lists unit names; the section requires no SDK behavior.

non_applicable.screenshots: Only for SDKs with a user interface; the Python SDK has no UI to capture.
non_applicable.view-hierarchy: Describes UI view trees; the Python SDK has no UI hierarchy.

non_applicable.span-outcomes: The SDK never emits transactions (span streaming only), so there are no dropped transactions to expand into span outcomes.
non_applicable.legacy-events: The SDK only sends envelopes and has no store endpoint path.
non_applicable.custom-transports: Only permits custom transports to skip client reports; requires no SDK behavior.

non_applicable.desymbolication: Python stack frames carry original module and function names, so there is nothing to desymbolicate.
non_applicable.startup-crash-detection: Targets mobile and desktop SDKs with offline envelope caches; the Python SDK has no on-disk envelope cache.

non_applicable.session-replay-flush: Session Replay is a browser and mobile feature; the Python server SDK has no replay.
non_applicable.replay-widget-sampling-timing: Requires a feedback widget and Session Replay, neither of which exists in a server SDK.
non_applicable.replay-manual-api-sampling-timing: Session Replay is a browser and mobile feature; the Python server SDK has no replay.
non_applicable.user-facing-platforms: Applies only to mobile, desktop, and browser SDKs.

non_applicable.user-agent-parsing: Browser attributes only apply to client-side SDKs; a server SDK has no browser.
non_applicable.mobile-native-attributes: OS and device attributes are for mobile, desktop, and native SDKs.

non_applicable.otel-log-format: Informational appendix; the SDK sends logs only as log items.
